subject: Money
title: The Reagan Revolution
description: A quick, practical guide to The Reagan Revolution.

hook.text: Reagan cut the top tax rate from 70% to 28%. CEO pay went from 42x workers in 1980 to 399x by 2021.

buildup.text: Supply-side economics argued that cutting taxes on the rich would benefit everyone through trickle-down growth.

discovery.text: Deregulation, union-busting, and tax cuts simultaneously increased corporate power and decreased worker bargaining.

twist.text: The economy grew, but the gains went to the top. From 1979 to 2019, the top 1% captured 21% of total income growth.

climax.text: Income inequality returned to 1920s levels within 30 years. The Great Compression was systematically reversed.

punchline.text: Trickle down. Stay at the top.

quiz.question: What happened to inequality after Reagan's tax and deregulation policies?
